implementation_audit_read_only.finding: notes keyed by day, fixed0.75 canvas aspect, one note/day, serif/sans/mono choices, PNG sharing. This does not satisfy1.18 multi-page/five-aspect behavior.
Web notes keyed by day and canvas720x960; same multi-page/aspect gap.

Current implementation is a single long settings screen; current1.19 official notes describe summary tiles plus detail pages. Supplied iOS screenshots depict older long-list layout, so target version must be recorded before visual parity claims.

images.classification: full app UI; platform/version not stated
images.observation: Empty map; spacious canvas; bottom-left stacked statistics; raised central recording circle; locate/layers right; fixed three tabs. Walker glyph and absent hamburger differ from supplied iOS reference. Do not treat as exact iOS layout.

images.classification: full app UI; platform/version not stated
images.observation: Walking statistics: ring/level header, large tabular-looking numeric distance with small unit, milestone line and novelty ratio, secondary 2x3 metrics card, today steps card. Screenshot width alone cannot establish iOS point sizing/font family.

images.classification: marketing composite with Android-styled phone frame; not full-screen capture
images.observation: Photo card on neutral background, timestamp/caption/category, delete/close/download controls embedded in promotional framing. Not usable for iOS native margins.

images.classification: full app UI; platform/version not stated
images.observation: Populated records: three weekly columns with previous-week values; dot calendar with ring selection; weekly review row; two shortcut cards; month aggregate uses discovery/new distance; route thumbnail/elapsed/date/new-distance/progress bar; persistent tabs. Some title regions redacted by publisher.

images.classification: official marketing composite containing iPhone UI; not flat screenshot
images.observation: Left proof map overlays precise black route on labeled streets; right map displays straight-line destination bearing and remaining distance, black location dot and large faint accuracy/heading highlight. Enlarged circular callout is marketing decoration.

images.classification: official marketing composite containing iPhone lock screen and replay UI
images.observation: Lock-screen Live Activity shows recording/distance/discovery/duration; right replay panel shows date, large total discovered distance, white route card. Marketing shadows/phone perspective must not be copied into in-app UI.

video.inspection: Downloaded playable MP4 stream; ffprobe verified24s; four frame samples at6-second intervals individually viewed together. Audio not inspected; full temporal playback not performed.
video.classification: Official App Store page Uber brand animation; changing street lines around central PlainWalk logo. No app interaction/UI tutorial.
video.conclusion: Playable branding media obtained, but full-operation footage remains unverified.

secondary_source.warning: Claims cross-platform shared maps; conflicts with current official FAQ saying shared maps iPhone-only. Prefer official source; do not implement/account it as verified Android parity.

limits: Six source images individually opened: three flat app screenshots, three promotional composites. None shows the notebook editor.
No full-operation YouTube/Shorts/Instagram video actually viewed; broad searches yielded no trustworthy direct footage.
